name: R1 Interaction Path
ascii:
Legend: [S] = user surface, [I] = stable index, (O) = user operation; `name` = source/symbol reference.

                         R1 REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

 (O) Select a DiagramSet                         `DiagramSetTreePanel`
       |
       +----> navigate grouped lineage --------> `DiagramLineagePanel`
       |     candidate batch / rank / star preferred view
       |     variants / call graphs / directory views / components / edits
       |     derivatives / imports
       +----> choose active artifact ----------> `App` selection handlers
       |
       v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [S] ACTIVE REPRESENTATION - orientation and manipulation surface         |
|                                                                          |
|  (O) `DiagramView`                                                       |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  (O) `AsciiSelectionGrid`                                                |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  [I] `RepresentationIndex` - stable revision-scoped element identities   |
|      mapped/highlighted presentation; stable subtree identity            |
+----------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
           |
       +----> hover / click mapped elements and display mapped/highlighted state
       +----> rectangle selection ----> `DiagramComponent` capture
       +----> mapped-element commands             `ElementCommandId`
       |       +-- reveal Evidence (only grounding entry)
       |       +-- collapse subtree (presentation only)
       |       +-- toggle highlight (durable grounded context)
       |       +-- buffer reference (mapped Evidence tray)
       +----> selected Evidence ----> transient call-graph focus pane
       |      (`callGraphFocus` / `CallGraphFocusTree`)
       +----> Representation layers: information rank and layer/transition feedback
       |      (`representationGraph` / `RepresentationLayersPanel`)
       +----> edit mode: markers; manual/LLM edits; undo/redo
       |       ----> publish new immutable lineage child (`EditOperationsPanel`)

 (O) Reveal mapped Evidence
       |
       v
[S] Representation -- mapped reveal --> [H] Evidence -- authoritative ranges --> [V] Corpus
    orientation/manipulation          grounded semantic hinge              verification surface

Reverse with pane history: [S] Representation <-> [H] Evidence <-> [V] Corpus
ONLY source-grounding path: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus
No Representation-to-Corpus shortcut; direct Corpus access is explicit browsing only.
